scope: Original-source internet review and installed API read-only inspection; no implementation, economics, services, orders or commits

sources.title: Hummingbot Grid Strike / grid_executor
sources.version_date: Guide published 2025-10-07; page footer 2026-10-23; master observed 2026-10-24, commit UNKNOWN
sources.grade: A: inspectable implementation; C: economic transfer
sources.finding: Finite levels, bounded outstanding orders, filled-level state, shutdown/held inventory. POSITION_HOLD get_net_pnl_quote excludes position_pnl_quote: executor report is not full marked portfolio equity.

sources.title: Chen/Chen/Jang Dynamic Grid Trading paper and original implementation
sources.version_date: arXiv v1 2025-06-13; repo main observed 2026-10-24, commit UNKNOWN
sources.finding: Explicit wallet/input-money/grid-boundary resets; BTC/ETH spot experiments 2021-01 to 2024-07. Paper attributes strong returns partly to crypto price appreciation. Zero-expectation claim is conditional on its model.
sources.reuse: Treat reset as an auditable cash/inventory transition. Reject spot IRR as proof for leveraged BTC/SOL and reject another adverse-grid sweep.

sources.title: pysystemtrade dynamic optimisation buffering
sources.version_date: develop observed 2026-10-24, commit UNKNOWN; Carver discussion reply 2022-02-09
sources.grade: A: original code and author clarification; C: CoinMaster economics
sources.finding: calculate_adjustment_factor uses max((tracking_error-buffer)/tracking_error,0); rounds proposed trades in contract space. Author says production uses actual live positions rather than prior simulated positions.
sources.reuse: Trade small target deviations only when costs warrant, using actual native inventory plus pending leaves. Never buffer away mandatory hedge or retain excess SOL after BTC reduction.

sources.title: Rob Carver: Uncertainty Principles — original ReSolve interview transcript
sources.version_date: Publication date not exposed in inspected page; accessed 2026-10-24
sources.grade: B: primary expert transcript, not strategy validation
sources.finding: At 08:41/09:51 conditional regime performance estimates have wide uncertainty; at 20:44 estimating Sharpe is difficult. At 1:29:56 he distinguishes execution mean reversion from medium-term trend and stresses costs.
sources.reuse: Preserve original EMA signal; investigate execution costs/participation without asserting a new regime predictor. No probability sizing from a tiny conditional set.

sources.title: Better System Trader episode 012 — Ernest Chan
sources.grade: B-/C: original interview publisher, inspected text is editorial breakdown, not verbatim transcript
sources.finding: Distinguishes momentum and mean reversion and strategy-level dependence; finite system failure control matters. These are research principles, not evidence that SOL is profitable as a hedge.
sources.reuse: Require separate economic justification for a tactical mean-reversion overlay. Do not rebrand old standalone SOL alpha as mandatory insurance or revive performance-based BTC cuts already tested.

sources.title: Freqtrade original position-adjustment documentation
sources.version_date: stable moving documentation observed 2026-10-24; release UNKNOWN
sources.grade: A: documented callback semantics; no economic evidence
sources.finding: Loose entry/exit conditions can retrigger each live throttle interval; backtest callback frequency differs. Docs advise checking last filled order and outstanding orders.
sources.reuse: Event-key idempotence, pending-order accounting, no re-add on every mark. No migration and no use of Freqtrade sizing semantics in native Nautilus.

sources.title: r/algotrading original Draw-down calculation discussion
sources.version_date: Exact publication timestamp not exposed; page shows relative age only; accessed 2026-10-24
sources.finding: Participants disagree about realized versus unrealized DD and discuss minute/hour/day sampling. The disagreement illustrates why metric definitions must be explicit; it proves no alpha.
sources.reuse: Keep native marked-equity high-watermark DD and disclose sampling limits; never use closed-balance grid profit as acceptance.

sources.title: Installed NautilusTrader source, local authoritative API check
sources.version_date: Installed distribution 1.231.0, METADATA verified 2026-10-24; latest web API not adopted
sources.grade: A: installed source semantics; venue behavior still requires acceptance
sources.finding: OrderFactory limit supports post_only/reduce_only and time_in_force; bracket has one TP and one SL, default OUO. Strategy.modify_order creates a command and can suppress it for closed/PENDING_CANCEL orders; cancel_order dispatches a command, not proof of completion.
sources.reuse: Native cache/events are truth; explicitly allocate three TP leaves and reconcile partial fills/cancel rejects. No assumption one OUO bracket solves unequal 3TP+SL.

mechanisms.name: Actual-fill hedge deficit controller
mechanisms.idea: One native reducer maps actual BTC/SOL inventory and outstanding leaves to required hedge floor and upper cap. Cancel excess pending adds first; never infer filled hedge from submitted order. Freeze valid closed-hour hMV/beta at activation; no BTC means no SOL.
mechanisms.novelty: Accounting/lifecycle prerequisite, not revived H_SOL ADD cap or a claim to cure DD. Old cuts/insurance do not establish this exact order contract or its profit.
mechanisms.rejection: Reject any duplicate add, double reservation, naked BTC increment after mandatory hedge denial, SOL above cap after reduction, zero-BTC SOL, or hidden missing-hedge interval.
mechanisms.acceptance: Future native deterministic partial/reject/cancel race scenarios; measure activation latency and undercoverage duration; if hedge cannot be acquired, block/undo incremental BTC risk. No tests run in this task.

mechanisms.name: Bounded market participation at unchanged E4 parent decisions
mechanisms.idea: Keep 83 EMA34/E4 signal times/sides and original quantity anchor. Compare finite market/marketable-IOC participation child with fixed spread/slippage ceiling, one reserved residual, frozen completion deadline and no indefinite chase. Retain intended original BTC TP3; keep three real reduce-only TPs under settled contract.
mechanisms.novelty: Targets lost participation rather than deeper adverse grids or doubling exposure. R2/R3 improved equal-notional bp but destroyed terminal compounding; higher fill rate alone is not benefit.
mechanisms.rejection: Reject if improved fills chiefly add losing exposure, cost exceeds incremental native cycle benefit, actual margin/capacity fails, or screen retention <70% S0 net profit. No source proves available alpha.
mechanisms.acceptance: Future event scenarios and native execution acceptance with spread/slip/fees/funding; compare entry fill fraction, time exposed, winner/loser participation, implementation shortfall and own-capital TOTAL/DD against fixed matched controls. Historical synthetic depth1000 cannot establish capacity.

mechanisms.name: Cost buffer for optional hedge target changes
mechanisms.idea: Mandatory floor repair and upper-cap reduction bypass all buffers. Only excess discretionary hedge adjustment uses a frozen no-trade band, actual positions and pending orders; round to native lots; finite rehedge count/turnover budget per BTC parent.
mechanisms.novelty: Avoids 607 rapid re-adds and corridor churn without removing required cover. This is execution economy, not another corridor alpha hypothesis.
mechanisms.rejection: Reject if saving fees increases required undercoverage, hedge miss, worst marked DD, or residual SOL exposure. Reject if economically worse than equivalent-factor BTC trim.
mechanisms.acceptance: Future native trace test for repeated marks, partials and beta refresh; account turnover, hedge cost, BTC-factor contribution and SOL residual; full economics requires new budget.

mechanisms.name: Factor-matched hedge versus BTC-trim control
mechanisms.idea: Compare signed SOL factor compensation and specific residual after costs with reducing the same BTC factor exposure. Use causal beta known before entry and actual evolving inventory; descriptive attribution cannot establish standalone residual alpha.
mechanisms.novelty: Avoids assuming SOL fill profits survive cap/compounding; existing R3 screen already found weaker/unstable benefits, so new implementation needs a concrete reason that changes this result.
mechanisms.rejection: STOP_SOL if after-cost protection is consistently inferior to equal-factor BTC trim or profit requires SOL while BTC flat/above cap.
mechanisms.acceptance: First use existing receipts only; eventual causal native replay with own capital required for an economic claim.

mechanisms.name: B5front30/H5, dynamic adverse-grid/reset or unconstrained tactical recycling
mechanisms.idea: Do not admit the attachment architecture as a new native candidate just because H1 DD is around45%.
mechanisms.novelty: None: known own-capital profit around40k and massive participation losses already fail the objective; reset/recycling does not supply missing alpha.
mechanisms.rejection: Already rejected by profit gate; no doubling exposure or parameter sweep to compensate.
mechanisms.acceptance: No new run. Only reconsider a specific semantic defect supported by receipts or genuinely different causal source of profit.
